launch.method: Direct repository JIT; original tile/warp/stage options and kernel source; device CU count sets persistent NUM_SMS/grid.

benchmark.publication_changes: Embed frozen launch options; recover measured source from Git when needed; add optional independent single-TG PERF capture. Default full-grid protocol and published full-grid performance are preserved. Single-TG dry-run plan labels clarified after capture; executable measurement logic unchanged.

stats.format: Complete raw PMD statistics concatenated in validation-then-samples order; stats_section is a zero-based block index. Individual raw hashes remain in each sample.

single_tg_perf.scope: Independent TG0 dispatch on the sbx2 device (2 dies / 96 CUs); original MNK, strides and compile options including NUM_SMS=96 when persistent. This PMD rotates the starting die between launches; each sample records the actual die/CU. Full-grid performance is independent of this capture.
single_tg_perf.selection: minimum system.gcSimCycles of repeats 1 and 2; repeat 0 excluded

original_published_record.note: Previous published record, embedded for provenance only.
